title: No-Harm Physics-Informed Inverse Learning with Residual-Calibrated Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2606.07153v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Physics-informed learning is increasingly used for partial differential equation (PDE)-governed inverse problems, but its reliability remains difficult to certify. This paper develops a no-harm certification-and-selection framework for physics-informed inverse learning. A learned reconstruction is accepted only when its residual-calibrated radius is no worse than the baseline radius, namely when $$R_{\mathrm{learn}}\le R_{\mathrm{base}}+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{safe}};$$otherwise, the method returns the baseline. The certificate combines data, physics, boundary or initial-condition, and optimization residuals. Under a conditional stability estimate, these residuals yield an a posteriori reconstruction-error bound and a deterministic uncertainty radius. translated_title: 无害物理信息逆问题学习与残差校准不确定性
translated_abstract: 物理信息学习日益广泛地应用于由偏微分方程（PDE）支配的逆问题，但其可靠性仍难以认证。本文为物理信息逆问题学习开发了一种“无害”认证与选择框架。只有当学习到的重构结果的残差校准半径不劣于基线半径时，即满足 R_learn ≤ R_base + ε_safe 时，才接受该学习重构；否则，该方法将返回基线结果。该认证结合了数据残差、物理残差、边界或初始条件残差以及优化残差。在条件稳定性估计下，这些残差可给出后验重构误差界和确定性的不确定性半径。对于由独立随机配点估计得到的物理残差，本文还推导出了高概率认证。在泊松源恢复、逆热传导等问题的数值测试中验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出一种“无害”认证与选择框架，通过联合数据、物理、边界/初始条件及优化残差构建后验误差界与不确定性半径，仅当学习重构的残差校准半径不劣于基线时才采用学习结果，否则自动回退到基线方法，从而为物理信息逆问题学习提供可认证的可靠性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a no-harm certification-and-selection framework for physics-informed inverse learning, which combines data, physics, boundary/initial-condition, and optimization residuals to derive a posteriori error bounds and deterministic uncertainty radii, accepting the learned reconstruction only when its residual-calibrated radius is no worse than the baseline and otherwise falling back to the baseline method, thereby providing certifiable reliability guarantees.
